// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// The passing half of bad-nested-relation-unprojected.txt: a nested relation
// needs its own select: exactly as much as the outer call does. This is the
// shape the schools screen actually wants, and it proves the rule can be
// satisfied rather than only avoided.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function schoolsWithStaff() {
  return db.school.findMany({
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      staff: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true, role: true, status: true } },
    },
  });
}
